title: OpenPaleoMedia
description: Images for Open Paleo, from open-paleo/media: outlines of dinosaur groups, each with its creator, source and license.

outlines.description: The outlines, by the name of the genus or clade each stands for, as the Open Paleo dataset names it. A genus shows its own outline if it has one, and otherwise that of the nearest clade above it that has one.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema the output follows. A new major version is a breaking change.

Outline.description: An outline of a genus, or of a typical member of a clade.

file.description: The cleaned SVG file, relative to dist/, such as "outlines/s/sauropoda.svg": drawn in currentColor, with a viewBox and no fixed size.

title.description: What the outline shows, for its caption: "Outline of a titanosaur".

depicts.description: The taxon the outline was drawn from, such as "Camarasaurus supremus".

changes.description: How the file differs from the creator's original, for credit lines: "Recolored", or "Recolored; flipped horizontally".

creator.description: Who drew it, to be credited wherever it is shown.

source.description: Where it came from, such as its PhyloPic page.

license.description: Its license, as an SPDX id. Share-alike outlines keep their license in the cleaned copy.
